LEGI DESIGN · ICONS · 101

Icons

Samurai Jack style: flat shapes with no outline; ink lines only for detail inside a shape. Every shape and line is a named part with its own colour, by default the realistic one (a brown reindeer). Each icon is shown in its default colours on paper and on the palette field, then as a one-colour silhouette (iconSvg(name, { colors: "currentColor" })). Under it: its parts and their default colours; recolour any of them with iconSvg(name, { colors: { antlers: "#fff" } }) or the CSS variable --rg-icon-<icon>-<part>. Then the emoji or Lucide icon it replaces.
